create_ddpmt_loss_wrapper: create a DDPMTLoss wrapper with mean reduction and a custom coefficient for DDP training
build_mae_loss_for_scalars: build a MAELoss module registered as 'mae' to compute L1 loss on scalar predictions
build_mse_loss_for_vectors: build a MSELoss module registered as 'mse' to compute mean squared error on vector predictions
create_per_atom_mae_loss: create a PerAtomMAELoss to compute L1 loss normalized by the number of atoms per structure
create_l2norm_loss_for_forces: create an L2NormLoss to compute the L2 vector norm of force prediction errors per atom
